# tensquads UI component index

@tensquads/ui is a React component library with 36 documented components. Live gallery: https://tensquads-ui-preview.mohanadgh.workers.dev/components. Install and setup: README.md. Agent skill: .agents/skills/tensquads-ui/SKILL.md.

## Start here

- [Design guide](DESIGN.md): Read this before you build a screen

## Components

- [ApprovalCard](packages/ui/src/react/ApprovalCard/ApprovalCard.md): Import `ApprovalCard` and `ApprovalCardProps` from `@tensquads/ui/react`. Pass a platform `approval_request` as `request`. The card displays its action, content, amount, optional labeled rule and limit, and approve or decline controls. `actionLabels` localizes action ids. `ruleLabels` maps rule ids to human-readable labels; an unmapped rule id is hidden. The amount appears first. A labelled rule names the limit, so it replaces the word "Limit" ("Refund limit $42.00"). Without a label the card shows "Limit $42.00"; a labelled rule with no limit shows the label alone. The task id comes from the request.
- [Badge](packages/ui/src/react/Badge/Badge.md): Import `Badge` and the `BadgeProps` type from `@tensquads/ui/react`. Badge is a plain, non-interactive `<span>` because UI SDK does not ship a Badge component or behavior for this label. It has no hand-authored ARIA role and is not focusable. Each tone keeps at least 4.5:1 text contrast on a selected DataTable row.
- [BarChart](packages/ui/src/react/BarChart/BarChart.md): Import `BarChart`, `BarChartProps`, `BarChartPoint`, `BarChartSegment`, and `BarChartKey` from `@tensquads/ui/react`. Pass ordered points with a date label and either a numeric `value` or an array of `{ key, value }` segments. Pass `keys` to name stacked series and select `muted`, `subtle`, `strong`, `success`, or `danger` ink. Use `subtle` for light historical comparison marks. Set `highlight` to an inclusive `[startIndex, endIndex]` range. Without a range, the last column is highlighted. A matching key's tone takes precedence over the highlight. Bars scale from a zero baseline; zero-valued segments have no visible mark. For integer data, the value axis rounds up to a nice maximum and shows three whole-number tick labels. For example, a largest value of 3 uses ticks at 0, 2, and 4. Fractional data uses the largest point total, with a minimum axis maximum of 1, and can show fractional ticks. Pass `formatValue` to format axis ticks, accessible column names, tooltip values, and the text summary, for example with a currency formatter. `formatValue` is a React-only callback and is not available in OpenUI streams. Hover or focus on a column to see its label, total, and stacked-series values in a tooltip. The chart includes a text summary, and its columns share one tab stop. Left and Right arrow keys move focus in the inherited layout direction. Points follow caller order from the inline start; pass the oldest point first for a time series. The x-axis shows every point label for up to 14 points. Longer series show the first label and every fifth label after it, with an aligned slot for every column. Columns and label slots shrink to fit the card, with a minimum of 2rem per point including spacing. Charts that need more width scroll within their viewport. Wrap it in `Card`; put the metric and time window in the Card subtitle. Pass `locale="ar"` to localize generated labels and screen-reader copy and format chart values with Arabic-Indic digits; the default is English. OpenUI accepts the same `locale` prop.
- [Bars](packages/ui/src/react/Bars/Bars.md): Import `Bars`, `BarsProps`, and `BarsRow` from `@tensquads/ui/react`. Each row has a label, a non-negative numeric `value` used for scale, and a `display` string shown to the reader. The component sorts rows by value in descending order and shows up to eight. Fills scale to the largest value, including fractional values; an all-zero dataset has empty fills. The default `ranked` style shows horizontal magnitude bars. Use `style="progress"` for plan rows and pass a `caption` for the average or other context. Growth may use `tone="info"` for the blue fill shown in the store owner reference; all other rows use one neutral ink. Wrap the chart in `Card`.
- [Button](packages/ui/src/react/Button/Button.md): Import `Button` and the `ButtonProps` type from `@tensquads/ui/react`. It wraps UI SDK's `Button` from `@ui-sdk/react/button` and keeps its native button behavior, `data-slot`, `render` prop, and forwarded props.
- [Canvas](packages/ui/src/react/Canvas/Canvas.md): `Canvas` renders a workflow graph in a pannable and zoomable surface. The host owns the graph. Node positions use logical coordinates, so `x` measures from inline start in both directions.
- [Card](packages/ui/src/react/Card/Card.md): Import `Card` and `CardProps` from `@tensquads/ui/react`. Card is a dashboard panel with one body. Its `title` and `subtitle` accept React nodes. It also accepts `count`, `actions`, `legend`, `footer`, and `flush`. The `inset` variant creates a nested item surface. Use `flush` when a table or other edge-to-edge content fills the body. Keep controls in the page header except for the table search and filters allowed by D24.
- [Chat](packages/ui/src/react/Chat/Chat.md): Import `Chat`, `ChatHeader`, `ChatLog`, `ChatUserMessage`, `ChatAssistantMessage`, `ChatWorking`, `ChatError`, `ChatStep`, `ChatEmptyState`, and `ChatComposer` from `@tensquads/ui/react`. Chat parts build a chat surface: a scrolling log, user messages, agent replies, working and error lines, and a composer. The host renders an agent reply as React content inside `ChatAssistantMessage`, with no avatar, name, or bubble. Use `ChatStep` for rows that report work by named agents.
- [ChatLauncher](packages/ui/src/react/ChatLauncher/ChatLauncher.md): Import `ChatLauncher` from `@tensquads/ui/react`. It is a floating button for opening the assistant chat. The host supplies `onClick` and controls navigation. `label`, `waiting`, and `locale` set its localized label and optional waiting count. The accessible name includes the count. The OpenUI definition accepts `label`, `waiting`, and `locale`; host navigation remains a React callback.
- [ChatReply](packages/ui/src/react/ChatReply/ChatReply.md): Import `ChatReply` and `ChatReplyProps` from `@tensquads/ui/react`. Pass a streaming reply string and its active locale. ChatReply renders Markdown text and fenced `openui` blocks in reading order. Each OpenUI block uses `TensquadsRenderer`; renderer props pass through except for the action and locking adaptations described below.
- [Chip](packages/ui/src/react/Chip/Chip.md): Import `Chip` and `ChipProps` from `@tensquads/ui/react`. Chip wraps UI SDK `Button` from `@ui-sdk/react/button`. A chip opens an attached object, so it uses button action behavior without a pressed state.
- [CommandPalette](packages/ui/src/react/CommandPalette/CommandPalette.md): Import `CommandPalette` and `useCommandPaletteShortcut` from `@tensquads/ui/react`. Provide flat groups, labels and an `onSelect` callback for each item. The palette filters labels and keywords, and closes after an item runs.
- [DataTable](packages/ui/src/react/DataTable/DataTable.md): Import `DataTable`, its column and row types, and the `EntityCell`, `PersonCell`, `StackCell`, and `StatusCell` helpers from `@tensquads/ui/react`. Provide an accessible `caption`, columns, and rows with stable string IDs. Cells accept text or React nodes. Use `StatusCell` for any `Badge` tone, including `info`. Set `align: "end"` for numeric columns and optionally set `width` or `mono`. `EntityCell` derives uppercase Latin initials from the first two words, or the first two letters when the name has one word.
- [DateRangePicker](packages/ui/src/react/DateRangePicker/DateRangePicker.md): Pick a start and an end date in one control. Enter dates in the two fields or use the calendar. The popup shows two months at 1024 px and above, one month at smaller widths, and opens as a sheet below 640 px.
- [Dialog](packages/ui/src/react/Dialog/Dialog.md): Import `Dialog`, its parts, and the matching prop types from `@tensquads/ui/react`. Dialog wraps UI SDK's `@ui-sdk/react/dialog` parts: `Dialog`, `DialogTrigger`, `DialogBackdrop`, `DialogContent`, `DialogTitle`, `DialogDescription`, and `DialogClose`. Each part keeps its UI SDK `data-slot`, `render` prop, open-state API, and forwarded props. The wrapper adds Agent-UI classes only.
- [Distribution](packages/ui/src/react/Distribution/Distribution.md): Import `Distribution`, `DistributionProps`, and `DistributionPart` from `@tensquads/ui/react`. Pass parts with a label and non-negative count. Parts are sorted by count in descending order; when there are more than six, the first five remain and the rest are folded into `Other` (`أخرى` in Arabic). The stacked bar uses neutral greys, and the key shows each label and bold count. Hover a segment to see its label and count in a native title. The whole and its parts are available in a screen-reader summary. Wrap it in `Card`. Pass `locale="ar"` to localize generated labels and screen-reader copy; the default is English. OpenUI accepts the same `locale` prop.
- [EmptyState](packages/ui/src/react/EmptyState/EmptyState.md): Import `EmptyState` from `@tensquads/ui/react`. Provide a short `title`, one sentence `description`, and optionally one action element. Use it in place of content when there are no records or when filtering returns no matches. The host chooses the action that will produce data.
- [Field](packages/ui/src/react/Field/Field.md): Import `Field`, `FieldLabel`, `FieldControl`, `FieldDescription`, `FieldError`, and their prop types from `@tensquads/ui/react`. These parts wrap UI SDK's field entry and preserve its root, label, control, description, and error slots, `render` props, state, and forwarded props. Place `Input` inside the field so UI SDK connects the label, description, and validation state to it. The default layout puts the label and control side by side.
- [Form](packages/ui/src/react/Form/Form.md): Import `Form` and `FormProps` from `@tensquads/ui/react`. Form composes a native form and the library FieldSet. It prevents page navigation on submit, forwards native form props, and calls `onSubmit` when enabled. `disabled` disables the field set and blocks submission. In OpenUI forms, named Field and Input text controls, Switch boolean controls, and SegmentedControl selected values participate in form state and submit together. Name the form with `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`. Compose its fields and submit button from the library.
- [Input](packages/ui/src/react/Input/Input.md): Import `Input` and `InputProps` from `@tensquads/ui/react`. Input wraps UI SDK's `Input` from `@ui-sdk/react/input`, preserving its native input, `data-slot`, `render`, value handling, and forwarded props. Use it in a `Field` or provide an `aria-label`.
- [Inspector](packages/ui/src/react/Inspector/Inspector.md): `Inspector` is a panel for editing the selected workflow node. The host floats it at `page-gutter` from the inline end of the canvas, aligned at the top with the Palette. It does not position itself.
- [Menu](packages/ui/src/react/Menu/Menu.md): Import `Menu`, its parts, and their prop types from `@tensquads/ui/react`. It wraps the UI SDK Menu from `@ui-sdk/react/menu`. The exported parts keep the SDK slots, `render` prop, forwarded props, and action callback shape. `MenuTrigger` supports solid, soft, and ghost styles. Checkbox and radio items show their checked state.
- [MiniMap](packages/ui/src/react/MiniMap/MiniMap.md): `MiniMap` shows the shape of a workflow that is larger than the visible Canvas. The map shows family-tinted node rectangles and a mask for the current viewport.
- [Node](packages/ui/src/react/Node/Node.md): `Node` displays one workflow step. Pass its `kind`, `title`, optional `meta`, and optional `branches`. Set `selected` to show the selected ring. The component draws its input and output ports. A `start` node has no input, an `end` node has no output, and a branch node has one output for each branch row. Use `Node` with `branches` for BranchNode; there is no separate `BranchNode` export.
- [OwnerMessageView](packages/ui/src/react/OwnerMessage/OwnerMessage.md): Import `OwnerMessageView`, `OwnerMessageViewProps`, `pendingQuestion`, and `approvalDecisions` from `@tensquads/ui/react`. Pass owner messages as `messages`. The view sorts valid messages by `seq`, keeps invalid messages out of the display, and reports invalid or unknown messages through `onUnknown`. Option questions emit an `OwnerAnswer` body through `onCommand`. The host adds `commandId` and `at` before posting it.
- [PageHeader](packages/ui/src/react/PageHeader/PageHeader.md): Import `PageHeader` and `PageHeaderProps` from `@tensquads/ui/react`. PageHeader begins a full-page view with a title, one subtitle line, optional actions at the inline end, and an optional metadata row. Keep the subtitle concise and name the counts the page describes. `headingLevel` defaults to `1`; use `2` when the header appears inside a nested preview or section.
- [Palette](packages/ui/src/react/Palette/Palette.md): `Palette` lists workflow node kinds in named sections. Press a row to ask the host to insert that kind. It does not position itself. A host can float it at `page-gutter` from the inline start of the canvas, aligned at the top with the Inspector.
- [SegmentedControl](packages/ui/src/react/SegmentedControl/SegmentedControl.md): Import `SegmentedControl`, `SegmentedControlItem` and `SegmentedControlIndicator` from `@tensquads/ui/react`. They wrap UI SDK's public segmented-control parts from `@ui-sdk/react/segmented-control` and preserve their slots, render props, value callbacks and forwarded props.
- [Sidebar](packages/ui/src/react/Sidebar/Sidebar.md): `Sidebar` is app navigation and has no OpenUI definition because navigation belongs to application chrome, not streamed content. Import `Sidebar`, `SidebarBrand`, `SidebarItem`, `SidebarSection`, `SidebarUser`, and `SidebarAgent` from `@tensquads/ui/react`.
- [Squadmate](packages/ui/src/react/Squadmate/Squadmate.md): Import `Squadmate` and the `SquadmateProps` type from `@tensquads/ui/squadmates` or `@tensquads/ui/react`. The component renders an accessible agent image with optional state motion. It accepts an `agent` slug, an `AgentState`, a square pixel `size` (default `64`), and a `locale` for the accessible name (default `en`). The image is not interactive and is not in the tab order.
- [StatTile](packages/ui/src/react/StatTile/StatTile.md): Import `StatTile`, `StatTileProps`, and `StatTileDelta` from `@tensquads/ui/react`. A tile shows one headline metric. `label` and `value` are required. Add an optional `glyph`, `unit`, `delta`, `foot`, and `series`. Delta tone is `positive`, `negative`, or `neutral`; the consumer decides whether an increase is good. Delta text includes its comparison period. Use `delta: null` and a `foot` when there is no previous period. Pass `series: null` or omit it for a metric without a trend. The sparkline uses the consumer-provided metric label as its accessible name. A sparkline needs at least two points and reverses in RTL so time follows the reading direction.
- [Switch](packages/ui/src/react/Switch/Switch.md): Import `Switch` and `SwitchThumb` from `@tensquads/ui/react`. They wrap the UI SDK switch parts from `@ui-sdk/react/switch` and preserve their slots, render props, checked state, callbacks and forwarded props.
- [ThemeToggle](packages/ui/src/react/ThemeToggle/ThemeToggle.md): Import `ThemeToggle` from `@tensquads/ui/react`. It switches between light and dark themes. The uncontrolled version uses `themePreference` to set `data-theme` on `<html>` and save the choice as `tensquads.theme`. A controlled version calls `onValueChange` and does not read or write browser state.
- [Toolbar](packages/ui/src/react/Toolbar/Toolbar.md): Import `Toolbar` from `@tensquads/ui/react`. It groups up to six icon controls in a floating toolbar. The toolbar has no OpenUI definition because it is application chrome with callbacks (D28).
- [Tooltip](packages/ui/src/react/Tooltip/Tooltip.md): Import `Tooltip`, its parts, and their prop types from `@tensquads/ui/react`. It wraps the UI SDK Tooltip from `@ui-sdk/react/tooltip` and keeps its root, trigger, content, arrow, and shortcut parts, `data-slot` values, `render` props, placement, open and delay options, and forwarded props.
- [WorkflowCard](packages/ui/src/react/WorkflowCard/WorkflowCard.md): `WorkflowCard` summarizes a workflow with a fitted graph thumbnail, status, and three stats. The thumbnail mirrors in RTL and is hidden from assistive technology.

## Templates

- [App shell](templates/app-shell/README.md): Lay out a signed-in workspace with side navigation, a page heading and one content panel.
- [Chat](templates/chat/README.md): Show a conversation with Petra, an inline form action and squad hand-offs.
- [Dashboard](templates/dashboard/README.md): Show store metrics, a revenue trend, work by squad and recent activity.
- [List and table](templates/list/README.md): Show a company table with search, a status filter and an empty state.
- [Settings](templates/settings/README.md): Show existing workspace rules, an edit form and operating limits.
